Ringing that won't stop? Give your ears something else to listen to.

Momental masks tinnitus with warm, broadband sound — brown noise, ocean, rain, and gentle fans — so the ringing fades into the background and you can finally sleep. No pills, no clinic, no glowing screen. Tap play and let it carry you off.

TINNITUS RELIEF & SOUND MASKING
- Mask the ringing: broadband noise (brown, pink, white) sits over high-pitch tinnitus so your brain stops chasing it
- Notch-style sound: tune masking to sit around your ringing, not on top of it
- All-night playback: steady, seamless sound — no loops, no sudden cuts

HEALING & SOLFEGGIO FREQUENCIES
- 432 Hz and 528 Hz tones, plus the full solfeggio set (396–963 Hz)
- Binaural-friendly: wear headphones for a deeper, more even field
- Free to start: core frequencies and noise colors, no paywall

SLEEP SOUNDS YOU ALREADY LOVE
- Brown noise and fan sounds for deep, flat, distraction-free masking
- Thunderstorm, rain, and ocean for sleep
- Baby and womb sounds — shusher, heartbeat, colic-calming white noise
- ASMR-style textures for tingles and wind-down

WHY MOMENTAL?
- Mix your own: blend frequencies, noise, and nature with per-sound volume — most apps only give presets
- 100+ sounds, mix up to 3 at once, works instantly, no account required
- Sleep timer with warmup and gentle fade-out
- Save unlimited mixes for one-tap relief every night
- Pure audio: no music, no voices — just sound engineered to mask and soothe
- Everything offline and synced across your devices

MADE FOR
- Tinnitus sufferers looking for relief and masking at night
- Light sleepers, insomniacs, and shift workers
- Parents soothing babies with white noise
- Anyone who unwinds to healing frequencies or brown noise

Frequently asked questions

Q: Can I use Momental for tinnitus masking?
A: Yes. Many people layer steady sounds like brown noise, rain, or fan noise to mask high-pitch ringing as part of a nightly tinnitus relief routine.

Q: What frequencies are included?
A: 432 Hz, 528 Hz, and the solfeggio set (396–963 Hz), for gentle nighttime listening.

Q: Can I mix multiple sounds?
A: Yes. Layer up to 3 sounds at once and adjust each one separately.

Q: Is Momental free?
A: Yes — core sounds and frequencies are free with all features. Unlock the full library with a subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Q: Does it work offline?
A: Yes. All sounds are stored on your device, so you can listen offline anytime.

Relief, not a cure — Momental helps you rest with sound. Start free tonight.

PitchLab turns your iPhone into a professional-grade pitch tracking system, no extra hardware required. Improve your pitching instantly with data. Break down your bullpen sessions, see pitch-by-pitch analysis, and get pro-level metrics.

Built by AI/Computer Vision expert Dr. Brian Martin and MLB player Jake Fishman, PitchLab delivers professional-grade pitch data using a single iPhone camera that has competitive accuracy to radar based technology.

Core Features
• Track Pitch Velocity – Get precise readings without a radar gun.
• Measure Vertical & Horizontal Break – Understand exactly how your pitches move.
• Active Spin & Spin Axis – See how the spin of your throw affects the movement.
• Automatically Trim Video – We automatically detect every throw and trim the video around it.
• Real Time - Our algorithm operates in real time, giving you results immediately after you throw
• Tracer Overlay - We automatically add a tracer overlay to clearly show how the ball moves
• Export Sessions - Export your entire session as one video for easily playback and sharing
• Session Review – Swipe through the video feed to watch back your bullpen.
• Performance Tracking – Monitor progress over time and set measurable goals.

INDIVIDUALS
Use PitchLab to track velocity, movement, and spin in real time. Review video of every pitch, share highlights on social media, and get the insights you need to improve your arsenal.

COACHES & FACILITIES
Automatically track your players’ pitch metrics and video. Analyze trends over time to objectively pinpoint areas for improvement. Automatically see video and data from clients training remotely. Ability to create more pitcher profiles and track data for each pitcher you coach.

Backed by Pros
Never before have pitchers been able to get advanced analytics without spending thousands on radar-based hardware. With PitchLab, every player can get the data that has shaped so many big-league careers, anywhere they train.
